headline: Bitcoin fell to its lowest price since July as the Dow dropped about 1,100 points, Sky's USDS stablecoin shrank by more than 30%, and Anthropic ended its first trading day up 17%.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap coin pages around 23:57-23:59 UTC Thu 19 Nov (06:57 Bangkok Fri 20 Nov). CoinGecko's homepage showed slightly lower prices (BTC about $61,869, ETH about $1,753). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 10, Extreme Fear (Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index)

stories.title: Bitcoin drops to its lowest since July as the Dow falls about 1,100 points
stories.summary: US stocks had a heavy sell-off on Thursday on worries about inflation and more Fed rate rises, and bitcoin fell with them to its lowest price since July. Higher interest rates make cash and bonds pay more, which tends to pull money out of risky assets like crypto. Money is also still leaving US bitcoin funds.
points: Bitcoin touched $61,658.52 on Coinbase, its lowest since July and 27.3% below its 21 October high, per The Defiant.
The Dow closed down 1,101.11 points (2.19%) at 49,097.06, the S&P 500 fell 2.02% and the Nasdaq 2.25%; the VIX fear gauge rose 13.79% to 27.98, per Yahoo Finance.
It was the S&P 500's sixth straight losing day, per Motley Fool.
Chicago Fed's Goolsbee is keeping a large December rate rise on the table, depending on the data, per Tokenpost's report.
US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $306.5 million on Wednesday 18 Nov, per Farside data reported by crypto.news. Thursday's figure is not out yet.

sources.label: The Defiant: bitcoin lowest since July

stories.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks by more than 30%, and its savings pool runs out of cash for withdrawals
stories.summary: After a report that North Korea-linked wallets used Sky's swap system, holders pulled money out fast and the supply of its USDS stablecoin fell by more than 30%. Separately, Sky's high-yield stUSDS savings pool is fully lent out, so depositors cannot withdraw right now. USDS itself is still at $1, and founder Rune Christensen says it is fully backed. The lesson: a savings product with a big yield can lock your money up when everyone wants out at once.
points: USDS supply fell by more than 30% to $3.2 billion as more than $1.5 billion of USDC left Sky's swap reserve, per CoinDesk; Christensen said USDS remains over-collateralised with about $10 billion in backing.

Inca Digital traced $518 million through the system across 422 flagged wallets, $101.9 million of it tied to North Korea; Sky says flagged activity is under 0.06% of more than $930 billion in volume, per CoinDesk.
The stUSDS pool holds about $162 million in deposits, is at 100% utilisation and showed $0 available for withdrawals, per Crypto Briefing.
About half of the pool's borrowing is attributed to Christensen, who calls the concerns overblown, per Protos.
The SKY token fell about 26% in 24 hours, per Crypto News Flash.

sources.label: CoinDesk: North Korean hackers used Sky's system
Crypto News Flash (via Cryptonews): SKY falls 26%

stories.title: Anthropic ends its first trading day up 17% at $97.17, after opening up 34%
stories.summary: Anthropic (ticker ANT) sold shares at $83, opened at $111.50 and then gave back about half the gain to close at $97.17 on a weak day for stocks. Crypto platforms let traders bet on its price before the Nasdaq listing; those products are not shares.
points: ANT closed at $97.17, 17.1% above its $83 IPO price, giving a market value of $1.27 trillion, per Forbes.
It opened just before noon ET at $111.50, per Forbes.
Perpetual futures tied to Anthropic traded around $105.50 at 10:30am ET on Hyperliquid, before the stock opened, per Forbes.
After hours it was at $95.69, down 1.52%, per Yahoo Finance.
The IPO sold 980 million shares at $83, raising $81.34 billion, per Decrypt.

sources.label: Decrypt: bitcoin death cross and Anthropic IPO

briefs.title: Ledger tampered-wallet probe spreads to Berlin and Dubai
briefs.summary: Ledger confirmed tampered devices in Berlin and is checking two in Dubai; an analytics firm estimates about $102 million was taken from 335 wallets in Southeast Asia. Ledger says buy only from ledger.com and it will never ask for your recovery phrase, per Bitcoin Magazine.

briefs.title: CFTC chair on how onchain venues could enter the US
briefs.summary: CFTC chair Selig said venues like Hyperliquid must partner with an exchange or get their own exchange licence to serve US users, per The Block.

briefs.title: Clarity Act unlikely before the new Congress
briefs.summary: Asked about the crypto market structure bill's chances this year, Sen. Moreno said "Zero. Zero." and suggested regulators could deliver much of it through rules; Rep. Hill said rules lack the force of law, per The Block.

briefs.title: Coinbase reportedly plans its own prediction markets
briefs.summary: Coinbase aims to run its own prediction markets in-house in the first half of 2027; it now offers them through Kalshi, per Bloomberg as reported by PYMNTS. Coinbase said it had nothing new to announce.

briefs.title: Strategy's STRC preferred stock below $100
briefs.summary: STRC closed at $96.19 on 18 Nov; Saylor said Strategy intends to keep buying it back below $100, after $228.1 million of buybacks from 9 to 15 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: US opens a centre to fight crypto scams
briefs.summary: The Homeland Security Task Force launched a Threat Disruption Center with TRM Labs as its main tracing platform; the FBI counted more than $11 billion in crypto-related losses in 2025, per The Block.

briefs.title: Binance wins $6.5B freezing order over October hack
briefs.summary: An Abu Dhabi court granted a worldwide freezing order against the hackers behind Binance's 29 Oct breach; a 1 Dec hearing decides whether to extend it, per The Crypto Desk.

Waller gives welcoming remarks at the College Fed Challenge; Cook speaks on "The U.S. Economy in Global Context", per the Fed.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), jobless claims and Q3 GDP (second estimate)
calendar.note: September PCE inflation was 3.6% a year and core 3.1%, per Fox Business; Oxford Economics' nowcast for October headline is 3.8%. Jobless claims are also due Wednesday (prior 203,000, per 1Trader), and GDP's advance estimate was 3.4%, per FinanceCalendar. Fed Beige Book at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok), per the Fed.
The monthly Deribit expiry is about 105,315 BTC, roughly $6.52 billion, per Loris Tools.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Decision Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok), with new projections. The current range is 3.75-4.00%; CME FedWatch odds of a quarter-point rise were about 90% on 19 Nov, with the rest on a half-point rise, per Admiral Markets.
